description: Etat des parkings en ouvrage EFFIA temps réel - Tours Métropole Val de Loire is a dataset listed in opendataTMVL open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tours Métropole Val de Loire. Ce jeu de donnée décrit les parkings EFFIA et indique les places libres restante en temps réel. Légende: Identifiant: identifiant du parking. Placeslibres: Nombre de places libres Exploitation: Nombre de places en exploitation Etat: Etat du parking (2=complet, 5=ouvert) Horodatage: Horodatage de l’information (sous la forme jj/mm/aaaa hh:mm:ss). Coverage: Tours Métropole Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are stationnement, parking, temps réel, effia, parking en ouvrage. The portal shows 3 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tours-metropole-fr-portal.
